name: Instant Crush Synth
description: Inspired-by approximation for the chorus's synth/pad material -- NOT a claim of reproducing Daft Punk's actual studio patch/hardware chain (spec section 43). Retuned darker/warmer/more restrained: this is the single obvious place to tune the Autoplay chorus-benchmark tone. Target feel: warm, slightly melancholic, restrained, smooth -- not EDM-bright, not cheerful, not harsh.
